title: Do Large Language Models Perform the Way People Expect? Measuring the Human Generalization Function
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not specifically measure any aspect of religion. Religious concepts appeared incidentally in some questions from the base benchmarks (e.g., a philosophy question mentioning 'God's commands'), but these were used to study human generalization about model capabilities in general, not to analyze the model's performance on religious topics.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. Religious concepts were only present incidentally in some of the questions used from the base benchmarks.
